cases.question: ¿Cuántos periodos contables con estado abierto estuvieron vigentes en algún momento de junio de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM accounting_period ap WHERE ap.status = 'OPEN' AND ap.start_date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND ap.end_date >= DATE '2026-06-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_periodos FROM public.accounting_period AS ap WHERE ap.status = 'OPEN' AND ap.start_date < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND ap.end_date >= CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el importe total de los comprobantes emitidos en julio de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.total_amount), 0) AS total FROM sales_invoice si WHERE si.status = 'Issued' AND si.issued_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND si.issued_at < DATE '2026-08-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(si.total_amount) AS importe_total FROM public.sales_invoice AS si WHERE si.issued_at >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND si.issued_at < CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se facturó por cada tipo de comprobante en julio de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT si.voucher_type, SUM(si.total_amount) AS total FROM sales_invoice si WHERE si.status = 'Issued' AND si.issued_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND si.issued_at < DATE '2026-08-01' GROUP BY si.voucher_type ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT si.voucher_type AS tipo_comprobante, SUM(si.total_amount) AS total_facturado FROM public.sales_invoice AS si WHERE si.issued_at >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND si.issued_at < CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY si.voucher_type LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se cobró por cada medio de pago en julio de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT pt.name AS medio, SUM(sp.amount) AS total FROM sales_payment sp JOIN payment_type pt ON pt.id = sp.payment_type_id WHERE sp.paid_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND sp.paid_at < DATE '2026-08-01' GROUP BY pt.id, pt.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pt.name AS medio_de_pago, SUM(sp.amount) AS total_cobrado FROM public.sales_payment AS sp JOIN public.payment_type AS pt ON sp.payment_type_id = pt.id WHERE sp.paid_at >= CAST('2026-07-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND sp.paid_at < CAST('2026-08-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY pt.name LIMIT 50
